name: Mark McQuade
bio: Mark McQuade is co-founder and CEO of Arcee AI, a company founded in 2023 that builds small language models and open-weight models. Earlier, McQuade held client-facing roles at Hugging Face and Roboflow. McQuade is a co-author of the MergeKit paper, which covers a toolkit for merging language models.
known_for: Co-founder and CEO of Arcee AI
